history.summary: D19 1BR at Terrasse priced at $870k / $1617 PSF with a solid 5.1%/yr resale-only appreciation rate backed by 111 URA transactions, and a confirmed Cross Island Line catalyst (CR9 Serangoon North, ~2030) 420m away. Listing sits ~5% above the $1538 district median PSF, but the CRL station proximity and sub-$900k entry justify a modestly positive view.
history.rating_rationale: Appreciation 5.1%/yr on a healthy 111-txn series (reliable, not thin), CRL station opening ~2030 within 420m is the strongest single future-uplift driver, and the $870k price keeps the buyer pool broad. PSF only ~5% over median is not overpriced. 1BR has a narrower owner-occupier pool but rents well in this established Serangoon Gardens fringe.
red_flags: 1BR is a niche resale segment vs 2BR
Serangoon North is not a designated growth node beyond the CRL station itself
catalysts: Cross Island Line CR9 Serangoon North MRT ~2030 within 420m
Established mature-estate location with stable rental demand
Sub-$900k entry preserves wide buyer pool

history.summary: Fairly priced (not cheap) 1BR in D19/OCR; the algo's headline 'cheapness' is a 3-comp cohort artifact and recent transactions show it is at, not below, market.
history.rating_rationale: The apparent value is overstated. A 538 sqft 1BR at Terrasse transacted recently at ~$1,635 PSF ($880k); this listing's $1,617 PSF ($870k) is essentially at market, only marginally below the last comparable - not a bargain. The algo's -6.0% age-adj relies on a thin psf_cohort of just 3 txns, so the size-band signal is low-trust per v3.4 priors. D19 is OCR (favourable forward region), which is the one genuine positive. But yield is weak (~2.3% gross reported) and there is no dated catalyst. With value roughly fair, thin cohort, and soft yield, this is a near-tie that lands at Neutral rather than Buy.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns = 3 - the cheap-vs-cohort signal is statistically unreliable
Asking PSF is at/just below the most recent comparable transaction - little real discount
Reported gross yield ~2.3% is below par for a 1BR
catalysts: D19 (OCR) sits in the strongest verified forward-appreciation region
